program: Wingless fixed-budget prospective support diagnosis on still-sealed code target
question: At the training-only common capacity selected by R2, does the zero-support diagnostic prospectively identify a structural risk that the still-sealed code target actually exercises?
hypothesis: Use only the structured and technical-prose sources for training, with the exact 15,819-byte budget and proportional exact-prefix allocation from R1/R2. Select exactly 256 motifs using the unchanged occurrence>=4 and best-successor-count/consistency/lexicographic ranking. Preserve eight reasoning classes by assigning the 256 selected motifs into eight deterministic 32-motif classes ranked by training decoded-motif frequency. Build the unchanged repaired-relation/depth-3 bridge on training bytes only, freeze each class's training-margin sample count and the zero-support class set, then open exactly the first 1,454 bytes of the still-sealed code source. Supported requires at least one zero-support class before target access and at least one target depth-3 query whose repaired top-1 falls in that frozen unsupported set. No target bytes or labels may influence capacity, motif selection, class assignment, thresholds, or the preflight decision. No modification is selected or retained.

portfolio_context.role: advisory-only; transfer-efficient learning objective, no self-modification retention

prior_evidence.interpretation: 256 is the largest preregistered candidate motif capacity supported by every leave-one-domain-out arm under the fixed 15,819-byte budget.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_design.training_allocation_rule: same proportional exact-prefix rule as R1/R2
frozen_design.motif_ranking: unchanged best-successor-count then consistency then lexicographic
frozen_design.class_assignment: sort selected motif IDs by descending training decoded-motif frequency, tie lower motif ID; assign rank//32
frozen_design.repaired_relation: same exact-pair repaired relation and depth-3 runtime cap as R5
frozen_design.risk_rule: flag iff at least one of the eight frozen classes has zero training depth-3 repaired-margin samples

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes; the training-only 256-motif/8x32 diagnostic freezes at least one zero-support class before target access and the still-sealed code target later exercises at least one of those unsupported classes.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but the prospective diagnostic is not confirmed on the code target.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, fixed-budget, motif-capacity, class-partition, target-isolation, decision-ordering, determinism, provenance, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter source identities, training/target budgets, 256 capacity, occurrence floor, motif ranking, 8x32 class partition, repaired relation, risk rule, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: compare no-change against a frozen bounded learning mechanism on a new preregistered future-data task under identical budgets; require a second disjoint transfer before retention

successor_if_negative.intent: attribute why the fixed-budget support diagnostic did not transfer to the code target before any modification-selection experiment
